title.en: Manager's commission and interest on capital
title.kn: ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರ ಕಮಿಷನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಡ್ಡಿ

hook.en: A manager is promised 10% of the profit. But 10% of which profit: before her commission or after it? The answer changes the amount.
hook.kn: ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕಿಗೆ ಲಾಭದ 10% ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಯಾವ ಲಾಭದ 10%: ಕಮಿಷನ್‌ಗೆ ಮೊದಲಿನದೇ ಅಥವಾ ನಂತರದ್ದೇ? ಉತ್ತರದಿಂದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Calculate manager's commission before and after charging it.
Record and show interest on capital.

narration.en: A manager is promised 10% of the profit. But 10% of which profit: before her commission or after it? The answer changes the amount.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕಿಗೆ ಲಾಭದ 10% ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಯಾವ ಲಾಭದ 10%: ಕಮಿಷನ್‌ಗೆ ಮೊದಲಿನದೇ ಅಥವಾ ನಂತರದ್ದೇ? ಉತ್ತರದಿಂದ ಮೊತ್ತ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: If commission is on net profit before charging the commission, it is NP × rate ÷ 100. If it is on net profit after charging the commission, it is NP × rate ÷ (100 + rate). It is debited to profit and loss and, if unpaid, shown as a current liability (commission payable).

points.en: P&L Dr; commission payable is a liability

narration.en: If commission is on net profit before charging the commission, it is NP × rate ÷ 100. If it is on net profit after charging the commission, it is NP × rate ÷ (100 + rate). It is debited to profit and loss and, if unpaid, shown as a current liability (commission payable).
narration.kn: ಕಮಿಷನ್ ವಿಧಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲಿನ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆದರೆ ಲಾಭ × ದರ ÷ 100; ಕಮಿಷನ್ ವಿಧಿಸಿದ ನಂತರದ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆದರೆ ಲಾಭ × ದರ ÷ (100 + ದರ).

body.en: Interest on capital is allowed to the proprietor at an agreed rate for the period the capital was used. Entry: Interest on Capital A/c Dr To Capital A/c. It is debited to profit and loss (an expense for the business) and added to capital in the balance sheet. Additional capital earns interest only from the date it was introduced.

points.en: Interest on Capital A/c Dr To Capital A/c
Expense in P&L; added to capital
Additional capital: interest for the period used

narration.en: Interest on capital is allowed to the proprietor at an agreed rate for the period the capital was used. Entry: Interest on Capital A/c Dr To Capital A/c. It is debited to profit and loss (an expense for the business) and added to capital in the balance sheet. Additional capital earns interest only from the date it was introduced.
narration.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಡ್ಡಿಯನ್ನು ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಅದನ್ನು ತಂದ ದಿನದಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ.

problem.en: Interest on the proprietor's capital of ₹2,00,000 at 6% p.a. is allowed by Nandi Agencies. Net profit after charging this interest but before charging manager's commission is ₹2,20,000. The manager gets 10% of net profit after charging such commission. Find the interest on capital, the commission and the final net profit.

steps.en: Interest on capital = 6% × 2,00,000 = ₹12,000: Interest on Capital A/c Dr To Capital A/c 12,000 (already charged in the ₹2,20,000).
Final net profit = ₹2,00,000; commission payable ₹20,000 is a current liability if unpaid.

answer.en: Commission ₹20,000; net profit ₹2,00,000; interest on capital ₹12,000 added to capital.

Net profit after charging this interest but before charging manager's commission is ₹2,20,000. The manager gets 10% of net profit after charging such commission. Find the interest on capital, the commission and the final net profit.

narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: CBSE board pattern: assertion–reason and case-based questions. Read the statements carefully before choosing.

points.en: Commission on profit before charging it: NP × r/100.
points.kn: ಕಮಿಷನ್ ಮೊದಲಿನ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲೆ: ಲಾಭ × ದರ/100.

points.en: Commission on profit after charging it: NP × r/(100 + r).
points.kn: ಕಮಿಷನ್ ನಂತರದ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲೆ: ಲಾಭ × ದರ/(100 + ದರ).

points.en: Interest on capital is debited to P&L and added to capital.
points.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ.

points.en: Additional capital earns interest only for the months it was used.
points.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಿದ ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ.

homework.en: Net profit before commission is ₹3,30,000. Find the manager's commission at 10% (a) before charging and (b) after charging the commission.

narration.en: Recap. Commission on profit before charging it: NP × r/100. Commission on profit after charging it: NP × r/(100 + r). Interest on capital is debited to P&L and added to capital. Additional capital earns interest only for the months it was used.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಮಿಷನ್ ಮೊದಲಿನ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲೆ: ಲಾಭ × ದರ/100. ಕಮಿಷನ್ ನಂತರದ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲೆ: ಲಾಭ × ದರ/(100 + ದರ). ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಿದ ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ.
